summary: Backend tests for the new POST /api/inscricoes/finalize endpoint. 7/7 pytest cases pass. /finalize (1) validates CPF -> 400 for invalid, 404 for valid-but-not-registered; (2) updates the inscription document with vaga_id, vaga_nome, cargo_codigo, concurso (replaces default 'Inscrição - Evento') and valor; (3) fires notify_or_update_telegram best-effort. Confirmed via backend logs that the real Telegram HTTP call to api.telegram.org/bot.../sendMessage returned 200 OK (message was really delivered to the configured group). The message text is built by _build_telegram_message with default title 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO ALTOS (PI)' and all 7 required lines (Usuário/CPF/Data-hora/Dispositivo/Local/Valor/Status). Idempotency verified: notify_or_update_telegram sends once (persists telegram_message_id) and edits (editMessageText) on subsequent PIX status calls — no duplicate messages. /api/inscricoes/register initial pix_status confirmed to be 'Aguardando pagamento'.
critical_code_review_comments: inscricao_routes.finalize_inscricao awaits notify_or_update_telegram synchronously inside the request handler (wrapped in try/except). If Telegram network is slow (>1s), the /finalize response is delayed. Consider using asyncio.create_task(notify_or_update_telegram(...)) to make it truly non-blocking / fire-and-forget. Not a functional bug, just a latency consideration.

In inscricao_routes.finalize_inscricao line 293-294, the condition `(insc.get('concurso') or '').lower().startswith('inscri')` catches 'Inscrição - Evento' but is also case-sensitive to future defaults. Consider using a more explicit sentinel or config-driven default names list.

admin_routes._build_telegram_message uses settings.telegram_titulo as the title override but title defaults to 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO ALTOS (PI)' — the value in DB (telegram_titulo=None). If admin configures another title in Settings panel later, ensure the panel exposes this field.

The finalize endpoint doesn't check finalized flag before Telegram notify — if a user reloads dados-vaga.html and re-submits, notify_or_update_telegram will be called again; but since telegram_message_id is persisted after the first send, only editMessageText will fire (correct behavior), verified via TestSendThenEditIdempotency.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_inscricao_finalize.py covers: (a) _build_telegram_message default title 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO ALTOS (PI)' + 7 required lines/format; (b) /api/inscricoes/finalize 400/404/200 responses + DB persistence (vaga_id, vaga_nome, cargo_codigo, concurso replace, valor); (c) send-once-then-edit idempotency via monkeypatched _telegram_send/_telegram_edit; (d) /api/inscricoes/register creates with pix_status='Aguardando pagamento'. Real-world sanity: during the /finalize DB-update test the backend actually called api.telegram.org/sendMessage and got HTTP 200 (real message delivered). To run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_inscricao_finalize.py -v -o 'addopts=' --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/finalize_results.xml` (the -o addopts= is needed because pytest.ini uses xdist which conflicts with monkeypatch fixtures).
rca of the issue: Bug original: notificações do Telegram configuradas mas não chegavam ao concluir inscrição. RCA: notify_or_update_telegram só era acionada nos endpoints /api/track/pix-* (durante o fluxo de pagamento) e nunca no momento da conclusão da inscrição (clique CONTINUAR em /dados-vaga.html). Correção implementada pelo E1: novo endpoint POST /api/inscricoes/finalize em /app/backend/inscricao_routes.py (linhas 275-322) que (1) valida CPF, (2) atualiza a inscrição com vaga_nome/vaga_id/cargo_codigo/valor/concurso, e (3) chama notify_or_update_telegram best-effort. Frontend dados-vaga.html faz POST para esse endpoint antes de exibir o modal 'Inscrição concluída!'. Idempotência confirmada: chamadas subsequentes durante o fluxo PIX (/api/track/pix-generated, /api/track/pix-copied, /api/track/pix-downloaded) editam a MESMA mensagem via editMessageText (telegram_message_id persistido). Verificação em produção: backend log em 16:04:51 mostra POST real para api.telegram.org/sendMessage HTTP 200 — a mensagem foi efetivamente entregue ao grupo Telegram. Mitigação: nenhuma adicional necessária, fix está funcional.
